children: Incannex Healthcare reported first patient dosing in its DReAMzz Phase 2 IHL-42X study and a U.S. patent grant while holding about $70 million in cash.
First patient dosed in DReAMzz Phase 2 dose-optimization study of IHL-42X for obstructive sleep apnea, informing Phase 3 design.
U.S. patent granted for compositions and methods covering IHL-42X with baseline expiry July 9, 2040, enhancing IP protection.
Approximately $70 million in cash and cash equivalents as of Aug 31, 2026, with no debt supporting further development.
Received over A$11.2 million in non-dilutive R&D tax refunds during 2026, strengthening near-term capital position.
